segments.name: Global Ceramic
segments.description: Designs, manufactures, sources, distributes and markets ceramic, porcelain and natural stone tile products for residential and commercial remodeling and new construction.
segments.evidence: Global Ceramic designs, manufactures, sources, distributes and markets a broad line of ceramic, porcelain and natural stone tile products used for floor and wall applications in residential and commercial channels for both remodeling and new construction.

segments.name: Flooring North America
segments.description: Designs, manufactures, sources, distributes and markets floor covering products for residential and commercial remodeling and new construction in North America.
segments.evidence: Flooring NA designs, manufactures, sources, distributes and markets a broad range of floor covering products in a variety of colors, textures and patterns for both residential and commercial remodeling and new construction channels.

segments.name: Flooring Rest of the World
segments.description: Designs, manufactures, sources, distributes and markets flooring and building panel products primarily for residential and commercial markets outside North America.
segments.evidence: Flooring ROW designs, manufactures, sources, distributes and markets a broad variety of laminate, LVT and sheet vinyl, wood flooring, broadloom carpet and carpet tile collections used in residential and commercial markets for both remodeling and new construction.

revenueModel.text: The Company is paid by home centers, retailers, distributors, builders, contractors and commercial end users who purchase its flooring products.
revenueModel.evidence: The Segment sells its products through floor covering retailers, home centers, mass merchandisers, department stores, e-commerce retailers, shop at home, buying groups, residential builders, independent distributors, commercial contractors and commercial end users.

changes.text: In 2023, the Company expanded its presence in Brazil through the acquisition of Elizabeth Revestimentos, a leading Brazilian ceramic tile business.
changes.evidence: In 2023, the Company further expanded its presence in Brazil through the acquisition of Elizabeth Revestimentos, a leading Brazilian ceramic tile business with manufacturing facilities strategically located throughout that country.

changes.text: In 2023, the Company acquired Vitromex, a leading Mexican ceramic tile business, solidifying its position in the Mexico ceramic tile market.
changes.evidence: In 2023, the Company also acquired Vitromex, a leading Mexican ceramic tile business with four manufacturing facilities strategically located throughout that country, further solidifying the Company's leading position in the Mexico ceramic tile market.
